items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You knew him personally. You lived – I saw an account that you lived with him for a couple of months, maybe just before he died. Is that right?

ctx.x: That was Gene. Benny Goodman told me – he said, “I respect drummers like Jo Jones, Big Sid Catlett, you and Buddy, but Gene was my man. He played for me.” That came from Benny Goodman. So there you go. Tommy Dorsey had a lot of great – Gene played with Tommy Dorsey for a while, and so did Davey Tough. There’s another guy that could play. He had a tremendous right foot. And he was a poet – wrote poetry. He had a lot of smarts.
You knew him personally. You lived – I saw an account that you lived with him for a couple of months, maybe just before he died. Is that right?
